paragraphs.text: The tenancy runs for twelve months. After that it continues month by month unless either side gives one month’s notice in writing. Rent is due on the first working day of each month.

The deposit is held by an approved scheme and returned within ten days of the final inspection. Pets are allowed only with written permission, and the tenant must have the carpets cleaned before leaving.

items.prompt: Notice to end the tenancy must be given in writing.
The deposit is kept by the landlord.
Tenants may keep a cat if they ask the landlord first.
The landlord pays for the carpet cleaning.
